data.cultural_impact: The name Jovana is deeply rooted in Serbian culture, especially in the Eastern Orthodox Christian tradition. It is a common name among the Serbian people, and is often given to girls as a sign of hope and gratitude to God for His grace and mercy. The name evokes a sense of religious devotion and strong family ties, as it is a reminder of the rich spiritual heritage and values of the Serbian people.

Tragically, both Jovana and her husband were killed during the Battle of Kosovo in 1389.
